## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem / Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🔧 Proposed Solution

How do you think this should work?

## 🌟 Benefits

Why would this be valuable to users?

- Benefit 1
- Benefit 2
- Benefit 3

## 📝 Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how to implement this:

- Option A: ...
- Option B: ...

## 🔀 Alternatives Considered

What alternative solutions or features have you considered?

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples from other tools.

## 🤝 Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'd be willing to implement this feature myself
- [ ] I'd be willing to help test this feature
- [ ] I just want to suggest it

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues or PRs here.

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context or information about the feature request.
